summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script that runs `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers, per-function string dictionaries, indirect call thunks) and, on install, downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the bundled sibling `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-CJS bundle heavily obfuscated with a string-array rotator (`WV8StW`) and a large numeric/string literal array (`n7gIxM`), so its behavior is opaque to Node-based review. The package's stated purpose is a Lerna workspace configuration helper, which has no functional need for a second language runtime. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: an unrelated runtime is fetched at install time to execute an obfuscated payload that Node-oriented tooling will not inspect, and it fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
